name: Financial Accounts
description: Financial account identity shared by ledger and portfolio applications.
notes: This module owns account identity and metadata. Transactions and Investment Holdings attach their own records; installing either does not require the other.
A bank or brokerage account is distinct from a utility-service or online-login account.

capture.identity: Use the selected account record; institution and lastFour narrow candidates but are not globally unique.
exclude: Utility accounts, login accounts, or a duplicate account created separately for a portfolio.
capture.workflow: Own financial account identity once; attach Transactions and Investment Holdings independently.
